rationale: The agent correctly verified the user (matched full name + zip to a single account), retrieved orders, and confirmed eligibility (pending) before making changes. However, it changed the delivery address without first obtaining explicit user confirmation, which violates the policy requiring confirmation before any order-changing write. For the item change, the agent did request and receive explicit confirmation, selected the least expensive available green variant, and processed the price difference correctly with accurate final information. The unconfirmed address update causes the overall outcome to fail the policy compliance bar.
